records.title: Decompression Sickness: A Review of Eleven Hospitalized Cases
records.reporting_document: Fryer DI. Subatmospheric Decompression Sickness in Man. AGARDograph 125. 1969.
records.locator: Fryer 1969, printed p. 265 (PDF p. 259), paragraph before RAF Table 12-1

observations.locator: Fryer 1969, printed p. 265 (PDF p. 259), paragraph before RAF Table 12-1
observations.note: Fryer attributes these admissions and the 20,000 reported exposures to the Cutler series. The precision of the denominator is unstated.
observations.protocol: Fryer describes the standard profile as 20 min of preoxygenation, an ascent to 43,000 ft, then hypoxia demonstration at 25,000 ft. Delivered oxygen, dwell times and individual exposures are unavailable.
observations.outcome_window: Illness identified through hospital admission. Timing of admission, nonadmitted outcomes and uniform follow-up are unavailable.

records.title: Decompression Sickness in High-Altitude Flight
records.locator: Meader 1967, Table III, printed p. 303 (DTIC PDF p. 4)
records.note: Table III provides recurring pain sites in four crew members already in Table I. One episode can involve multiple sites. Table III prints 16 episodes for crew I and two for crew K. Table I gives 19 and three, respectively. The exact membership of each subset and the reason for the different totals are unavailable.
